items.title: Constellation Energy Sinks 10% in a Week as AI Stocks Slide, Giving Back Its Earnings Jump. Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy fell 10% in the past week as AI stocks sold off, giving back most of its jump on a third-quarter beat and guidance raise. NuScale, Oklo and Cameco fell even more, and most of the week’s analyst news on Constellation was higher price targets.

items.title: Constellation Energy (CEG) Following Its Earnings Beat And Guidance Hike Looks Cheap Versus Fair Value
items.summary: Constellation Energy (CEG) is back in focus after its third quarter report, with sales of US$9.55b and net income of US$1.84b, as well as raised full year adjusted operating earnings guidance. Constellation Energy’s third quarter beat and guidance hike came against a weaker tape, with the share price down 28.26% year to date and the latest close at US$262.74, even though the 3 year total shareholder return is up 117.14%. items.title: Oklo Just Dropped 22% in a Month. What Would It Take to Get OKLO Stock to $25?
items.summary: Oklo has no operating power plant, a $3.1 billion cash cushion, and a stock that keeps sliding while Wall Street's targets sit far above it. The real question is which milestones could change the story, and which could break it.

items.title: $100,000 in Dominion Energy and Exelon Could Pay $3,846 a Year in Dividends
items.summary: One utility has raised its payout every year since a 2022 split, while the other has frozen its dividend for years and faces a merger vote. Which one deserves the bigger spot in a retiree's monthly income plan?

items.title: GE Vernova Is Down 34% From Its July High Despite 3 Guidance Raises. Is It Time to Buy?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGE Vernova (GEV:NYSE) is down 34% from its July high, even though it raised its 2026 guidance after each of its last three reports. The biggest drops came from outside the company, in selloffs that also hit Vertiv (VRT:NYSE) and Bloom Energy (BE:NYSE).

items.title: XLU vs VPU: Which Utility ETF Gets More From the AI Power Rush?
items.summary: Two cheap utility funds deliver nearly identical returns, yet they hold very different bets on who profits from data centers' hunger for electricity. The gap hides in how each fund treats its giants and its long tail of smaller names.

items.summary: The $39.13 billion fund bought $237.5 million of Home Depot and $175.7 million of Constellation Energy, both new positions, while trimming Cisco by $185.4 million.
